sentences.text: As midnight approached, the house began to stir, witnessing 'the machines waking up' at 00:10.
The energy readings showed an unexpected surge, with an observed amount of 90 Wh during the appliance energy spike.
This strange fluctuation was far above the projected expectation of 40 Wh, indicating a hidden ghostly activity.
This playful haunting persisted in the house until 00:30, leaving behind the peculiar sign of 'the machines waking up'.
